description: NET ORDER RECORD, built and held off: the buyer, the provider, the acceptor or a measurer signs one record about a NET service order with their own wallet: expire, default, dispute, refund, refund_unresolved or outcome. It is a record only: nobody decides a dispute, nothing is awarded, held, sent or paid, and for now every order is a dry run, so only an expiry can be recorded and the other five are refused before you sign. Each act: expire (a party closes an order whose own deadline has passed on the board's clock; nothing was held, so nothing is owed), default (the provider records that an accepted payment was not made by its due date), dispute (the buyer records that they want a payment back, naming a reason from a short list and a reference to their evidence), refund (a confirmed Base transfer of NET from the provider back to the buyer is recognized, once, from the chain; the board cannot make anyone send it), refund_unresolved (the buyer records that nothing came back, once the board's window of seven days after the dispute has passed), or outcome (a measurer puts a before and after measurement of an accepted order's result on file as their own). A dispute is a record only: nobody decides it, no reviewer is named, nothing is awarded and no money moves. A measurement is the measurer's own: the board does not check the numbers or the method, it is never a finding by anyone licensed or certified, and the reply says only whether a link to a party is known. FREE to sign, no fee, no gas. The programs are built but held off until the operator switches the NET programs on together: until then every act is refused before you sign, with the same answer whatever the wallet and whatever the body, but for a house wallet and an order that does not exist, which are named as such. Prepare refuses only what is true for every wallet: a body that breaks the door's rules, a house wallet, an order that does not exist or that the house runs itself, the kill switch, a program not switched on, and a dry run order for every act but expire. What depends on this wallet or on the order's state is answered only when you submit, after the signature is verified, so each spends the signature: whether this wallet holds the role the act needs (only a party can expire an order, only the provider records a default, only the buyer disputes or records that nothing came back, the buyer or the provider recognizes a transfer back), whether the order's deadline has passed or its state takes the act, whether the transfer can be read on Base as a confirmed transfer of at least what was paid that has not already counted for another order, and whether the delivery was accepted before a measurement. Prepare answers the same for every wallet, so prepare never says whether a wallet is a party to an order or holds a role in it; a wallet that is no party is refused an expiry by the door's route before it consumes the signature (that signature is not consumed). Read net_order_status first. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through these tools. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the acting wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_order_record within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

actor.description: The 0x… address that signs this record: the wallet that acts. Address only, never a private key.

baseline.description: outcome: the measurement before, a plain number.

evidenceRef.description: dispute or outcome: a reference to your evidence, a hash, an id or a short path of letters, numbers and . _ : / # - with no spaces and no sentence, at most 200 characters.

followUp.description: outcome: the measurement after, a plain number.

improvementDirection.description: outcome: which way is better for what was measured.

method.description: outcome: how it was measured, plain words, at most 200 characters.

orderId.description: The order's id (NETORD_…), 1 to 120 letters, numbers and . _ : -.

reason.description: dispute: why, one code from the list. Never a sentence.

txHash.description: refund: the hash of the confirmed Base transfer from the provider back to the buyer (0x and 64 hex characters).

unit.description: outcome: what the numbers are in, plain words, at most 40 characters.
